name: Clara B.
text: They take such good care of my Nova and she LOVES the staff and other dogs at daycare. We love happy pets!! I trust no one else to take care of my baby.

name: Natalie K.
text: Staff is present in every room and watching the dogs, not on their phones… they genuinely care for your pets.

name: Sonya K.
text: My boys are treated like kings at Happy Pets Palace!

name: Diane
text: I was impressed with what I saw on camera anytime I checked!! … even the care and love shown to the boarders during the night time potty breaks was above and beyond.

name: Ashtyn C.
text: I was filled with joy watching him play, socialize, and get lots of pats from their very friendly staff.

name: Charles W.
text: We have been a customer for many years. We trust the staff to care for our furry kids.

name: Eileen D.
text: The staff is so kind and remembers him by name… and is always professional! We highly recommend them!

name: Jon T.
text: Great staff, they took wonderful care of our two dogs… I won't hesitate to use them again anytime we are here in Arizona.

name: Teresa D.
text: Happy Pets treats our dog wonderfully and he comes home tired after playing all day! I love the web cams.

name: Trina J.
text: They treat my little ones like their own. The staff is always friendly.

name: Rogelio N.
text: More than five stars!!! … Very clean, friendly and professional. Staff is amazing and always smiling.

name: Miao C.
text: My dog Atlas was happy to be there and was able to friendly to everyone, that's what I need and what he needs!
